name: UI Design Review
description: Review interface design quality and return fixes: layout and visual hierarchy, type system (scale, line height, alignment), colour pairing and contrast, spacing consistency, restraint in motion, and WCAG accessibility conformance, flagging common UI anti-patterns. Also usable as a design-principle reference when building new interfaces. Use this skill whenever the request asks for a review, a critique of what is wrong, an accessibility check, or says an interface looks unprofessional.
